budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Extinguish all fire while preserving all three seedbeds, using spatial resupply, cooling, fuel removal and repair.
task.natural_termination: Failure if any seedbed reaches zero health; otherwise success if all heat is zero. Failure wins simultaneous natural conditions.
task.interaction: Movable specialists target actual adjacent cells. Spray precedes cutter/repair eligibility; synchronous finite-fuel fire and delayed resupply change later opportunities.
task.observation_access: All current mechanism-relevant state is public. Each actor gets the exact declared flat observations and structural masks. Actions are public only after commitment; external PRNG provenance and future submitted actions are excluded. Derived scene arrays add no policy information.

native_event_definitions.meaning: Active slots from the last non-absorbing transition; deduplicate by episode, event_tick and slot
Kind code describing the last committed transition event in each slot; see mechanism.md
Actual integer payload for each active event, including changes and gross repair/damage or capture progress
Resulting tick per active event, -1 for inactive; not a counter that increments on redraw
Joint ending level; does not create another terminal event on absorbing calls
Current public wind 0 north,1 east,2 south,3 west

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
